name: pentecost-church-begins
description: Followers of a crucified Galilean teacher gathered in Jerusalem and began preaching his resurrection, starting a new movement.

name: mani-founds-manichaeism
description: A Persian prophet announced a revelation from a divine twin and founded a dualist faith that spread across Eurasia.

name: anan-founds-karaite-judaism
description: A Babylonian scholar rejected the oral law and urged Jews to base their faith on scripture alone.

name: druze-faith-emerges
description: Preachers in Cairo proclaimed a new doctrine around the Fatimid ruler, founding a secretive faith still practised in the Levant.

name: bruno-founds-carthusians
description: A German-born scholar and six companions built a hermitage in the Alps, starting an order of silent contemplatives.

name: cistercians-founded-citeaux
description: Monks left a wealthy abbey to follow the Benedictine rule more strictly in a Burgundian marsh, founding a new order.

name: knights-templar-founded
description: A French knight and a few companions vowed to protect pilgrims in the Holy Land, forming a famed military order.

name: peter-waldo-waldensians
description: A wealthy Lyon merchant gave up his goods to preach in poverty, inspiring a lay movement later condemned as heretical.

name: dominic-founds-dominicans
description: A Castilian priest won approval for an order of preaching friars devoted to teaching and countering heresy.

name: smyth-founds-first-baptists
description: English exiles in Amsterdam baptised themselves as believers, forming the first congregation of its kind.

name: ammann-founds-amish
description: A Swiss Anabaptist elder broke from the Mennonites over strict shunning and plain living.

name: wesley-heart-strangely-warmed
description: At a London meeting an Anglican priest felt assurance of salvation, igniting the Methodist movement.

name: ann-lee-shakers-america
friendly_name: Ann Lee Brings Shakers to America
description: An English preacher led a small band across the Atlantic to found a celibate communal sect in New York.

name: smith-founds-church-of-christ
friendly_name: Smith Founds the Church of Christ
description: A New York farmer who published a new scripture organised a church that became the Latter-day Saints.

name: eddy-charters-christian-science
description: A New England author who taught that illness yields to prayer chartered her own church in Boston.

name: azusa-street-revival
description: Prayer meetings in a Los Angeles mission, marked by speaking in tongues, launched a global movement.

name: rastafari-begins-coronation
description: The crowning of an Ethiopian emperor was hailed by Jamaican preachers as the fulfilment of prophecy, launching a new faith.

name: missionaries-of-charity-founded
description: A nun in Calcutta won approval for a new congregation to serve the poorest of the poor.

name: lavey-founds-church-of-satan
friendly_name: LaVey Founds the Church of Satan
description: A San Francisco showman proclaimed a new year and an atheistic religion built on indulgence and individualism.
